requirements.retained_contract: Missing source, facts, calculations and method work remain internal; human acceptance is not a reason to outsource unfinished work.
requirements.current_assessment: Feasible internal source recovery, arithmetic, method repair and document review continue before any paid referral. A blocked source limits its claim, not independent ready work.
requirements.remaining_work: Prepare source-specific proposed answers, counterarguments and checked consequences before any later professional question. No engagement, outreach, cost authority or human acceptance is inferred.

current_sources.review_basis: Current changed passage/delta inspected; scoped author reassessment

gaps.title: Reconstruction defines the answer more precisely than the algorithm
gaps.original_obligation:
specify one bounded reference model, its template registry,
candidate-generation procedure, constraint lowering, scope exclusions,
sufficient-state checks and partial-search semantics. Include exact examples
of an admissible history retained, an incompatible history rejected, and an
economically relevant possibility outside the declared scope. A solver witness
must remain distinct from a coverage claim.
gaps.current_assessment: The bounded joint reconstruction contract is preserved; later real-source witnesses expose unidentified revenue, purchases, assets and lease movements.
gaps.remaining_work: Extend templates and query-specific memory from actual evidence. A compatible witness or complete source-unit reading is not completeness over real histories.

gaps.title: The normative language and IR contracts remain incomplete
gaps.original_obligation:
publish the complete Core 0 schema and reference package,
precise typing/context rules and function contracts, serialisation rules and
matched source-to-IR-to-result fixtures. Implementers need reproducible outcomes
for valid and invalid programs, not just agreement on names of operations.
gaps.current_assessment: The portable language/type/API design is carried forward, with added source/admission and adapter examples.
gaps.remaining_work: Keep the legacy Core0 boundary, unknown precision and unadmitted contexts explicit; independent lowering, package and interface conformance remain pending.

gaps.title: Ordinary disclosure uncertainty can leave the promised solver fragment
gaps.original_obligation:
enumerate supported formula classes and solver operations,
including rounding, strict bounds and attainment. Where valid, use a linear
parameterisation: fixed amount F and floating amount V, with F+V=D and F,V
nonnegative; then future interest at known rates is linear in F and V. Specify
when that rewrite is equivalent to the intended model and when additional
fraction restrictions prevent it. Unsupported cases must retain the model and
return a clearly limited answer, with declared computational budgets.
gaps.current_assessment: The finite/rational fragment and capability-failure semantics are unchanged; the new FX arithmetic stays conditional and exact within the authored example.
gaps.remaining_work: Each nonlinear, quantised or approximate extension needs a justified method and failure/tolerance contract before its own validation; no general solver claim is added.

gaps.title: The first corporate accounting package is an inventory of duties
gaps.original_obligation:
provide one deliberately bounded corporate profile with an
opening state, event schedules, journal templates and all statement mappings.
Carry it across annual and interim periods, including a correction and one
perimeter or currency case. Every supported operation needs its assumptions,
preconditions, state changes and expected reports; explicit exclusions are
acceptable. A balanced financing illustration does not specify this package.
gaps.current_assessment: Northstar's complete bounded package remains, with added Apple operating/tax examples and conditional FX profit/OCI/cash reconciliation.
gaps.remaining_work: Obtain actual corporate transaction, tax, settlement and measurement facts and complete the real note/report consequences; the local cases do not form a full company projection.

gaps.title: No complete filing-to-forecast reference case tests the central workflow
gaps.original_obligation:
add a complete synthetic fixture whose hidden history is known
and a bounded, named real annual/interim disclosure case. Show representative
notes including narrative qualifications, missing terms, a contradiction and
a revised comparative. A worked specification can be written before the
engine exists; the gap is not simply the absence of production code.
gaps.current_assessment: The named real cases now cover much more than financing; the 502-record crosswalk identifies how bounded Apple evidence enters the manuscript.
gaps.remaining_work: Close the declared incorporated package and material query dependencies, then connect the real case through all affected statements. Preserve unknown private facts and supported alternatives.

gaps.title: Forward economic and probability models remain interfaces
gaps.original_obligation:
specify one transparent scenario/operating baseline and its
information timing. For the optional probabilistic stage, supply a worked
joint model and an evidence-update example. Target-specific calibration is a
later empirical task, not a prerequisite for documenting those methods. P0
need not wait for a full Bayesian engine.
gaps.current_assessment: Explicit scenario, joint-law and failure semantics are preserved; real narratives and conditional settlement alternatives provide additional examples.
gaps.remaining_work: Supply company-specific structural and information assumptions; target-specific calibration and continuous inference require separate protocols. No forecast validity follows from bookkeeping checks.

gaps.title: Standards, banks and insurance are largely deferred requirements
gaps.original_obligation:
define operation-level scope and primary authority for the
first supported treatments. Add matched cross-standard examples and bank,
insurance and hybrid-instrument record/transition examples. Expand actuarial,
regulatory and accounting literature alongside each method specification.
gaps.current_assessment: Actual lease adoption, bank credit distinctions, FX, insurance guarantees and transition methods materially extend the prior sector preparation.
gaps.remaining_work: Complete operative standards, actual contract/entity facts, priced guarantees, acquisition/reinsurance interaction and broader financing/credit methods. Current authority and empirical actuarial evidence remain distinct.

gaps.title: Literature breadth exceeds the depth of the follow-up screening
gaps.original_obligation:
record actual screening decisions for relevant candidates;
use an unreviewed status until a decision exists. Inspect direct competitors,
extensions, corrections and negative findings, expanding each implementation
method's supporting literature. Do not treat the mere existence of six JSON
ledgers as evidence that the literature policy has been satisfied.
gaps.current_assessment: New technical reading narrows selected software/insurance questions; source recovery now records Tamer access failures and a verified wrong Caiani identifier.
gaps.remaining_work: The four foundational full texts remain blocked and wider competitor/version/correction/omission work remains unfinished. New retrieval routes require new evidence, not repetition of failed URLs.

gaps.title: Tool selection is a shortlist, without demonstrated adapter contracts
gaps.original_obligation:
specify the adapter inputs, outputs, errors and supported
subsets; demonstrate the smallest important exchanges with recorded versions.
An integration spike is an implementation-time check. The design can already
define the expected exchange and fallback without asserting performance or
superiority. Broad benchmarking is unnecessary at this stage.
gaps.current_assessment: Matched DSL/typed-library comparisons remain specified, while source-level adapter, model and dependency failure cases are more concrete.
gaps.remaining_work: Finish proposed interfaces and version/terms boundaries; later pinned execution and matched empirical comparison are still needed for compatibility or superiority claims.

gaps.title: Acceptance and completion are not yet determinate
gaps.original_obligation:
turn the central cases into canonical inputs and expected
outputs; define the initial corpus and review decisions; select justified
release criteria and workload budgets before evaluation. Universal arbitrary
accuracy cutoffs are not needed. Maintain an open-decisions register identifying
what must be settled before each stage can be accepted.
gaps.current_assessment: The current refresh covers every original requirement and gap and preserves the negative independent/human acceptance boundary.
gaps.remaining_work: Resolve substantive design blockers, then seek the applicable independent assessment; counts, clean builds and author checks cannot confer full readiness.

gaps.title: Whole-report coverage and narrative formalisation need a procedure
gaps.original_obligation:
one complete filing manifest, source-span disposition and
cross-reference example; typed narrative records; a mapping from disclosures
to supported constraints or explicit unresolved obligations. Preserve separate
coverage meanings and defined denominators. Do not score parsed pages as
formalised financial meaning, or turn "substantially all" into an invented
numeric threshold.
gaps.current_assessment: The three coverage populations are explicit; complete bounded Apple source readings and JPMorgan omitted-range annotations extend the initial preparation.
gaps.remaining_work: A complete declared filing manifest must retain all material meanings, references, unknowns and query consequences. Source-unit retention and row dispositions are not exhaustive semantic translation.

gaps.title: Cross-company concepts and aggregation need formal mapping semantics
gaps.original_obligation:
a mapping registry and application rules, with cases where
similar labels mean different measurements and different labels mean the same
quantity. Define what proves a partition disjoint/exhaustive, how unallocated
residuals are represented and how perimeter/context changes affect mappings.
The representation need not impose one universal chart of accounts, but it
must specify how comparability is established or left unresolved.
gaps.current_assessment: Actual dated segment labels, product/geographic classifications, parent/IHC restrictions and the FX case clarify contexts and consolidation consequences.
gaps.remaining_work: Adjudicate the real mappings, controls, dimensions and overrides; test their composition and aggregation later without imposing a universal chart of accounts.

gaps.title: Multiple clocks are identified without complete historical query rules
gaps.original_obligation:
a multi-date example with explicit publication, ingestion,
economic and reporting times, original and revised amounts, and the exact
records/results returned by each supported view. Show invalid year-to-date
subtractions across revisions as well as a valid one. Declare unsupported
timing assumptions rather than silently using the latest available row.
gaps.current_assessment: Actual restatement/adoption examples and 35 supplemental declared dates improve chronology; the frozen 56/136 count remains historical evidence.
gaps.remaining_work: Exact-byte availability, unresolved report dates and timezones still constrain as-of use. Later transition or authorisation evidence cannot be imported into earlier investor knowledge.

gaps.title: Scenario modes and permitted information need enforceable contracts
gaps.original_obligation:
declare supported scenario kinds and represent them in the
schema. A first release can explicitly support exogenous stress only without
claiming the other operations. Show how a manager and an allowance calculation
receive current information while future simulated outcomes remain hidden.
Explain when new observed evidence updates historical weights and why merely
selecting a hypothetical stress does not do so.
gaps.current_assessment: The information/scenario contract is unchanged; narrative service-access examples retain unknown causal strength and weights.
gaps.remaining_work: Bind each supported scenario to a structural model and permitted information; execute access, intervention and result semantics only with their own validation.

gaps.title: Different kinds of uncertainty need different admissibility rules
gaps.original_obligation:
define these distinctions in the model and review contracts,
including links between dependent uncertainties. Show an admissible alternative,
an evidence-refuted alternative and an unsupported accounting treatment.
Preserve a possibly erroneous source assertion as evidence without silently
endorsing its treatment. This requires no new fraud-detection product.
gaps.current_assessment: Actual elections, unknown lease movements, conditional FX classification and revised insurance bases demonstrate distinct admission questions.
gaps.remaining_work: Work source-reference conflict decisions across review layers without turning a rejected locator into a viable accounting treatment; later cross-category conformance remains necessary.

gaps.title: Aggregation and history compression need a practical resolution policy
gaps.original_obligation:
define resolution metadata, state requirements and a small
set of justified transformations. Include one grouping that preserves the
requested results and another that loses a rate, maturity or guarantee
exposure. Declare the scope/error of approximate aggregation and retain its
source/detail references. Changing the query must trigger a sufficiency check.
gaps.current_assessment: The economic-memory contract is carried forward; guarantee, cohort and maturity examples show concrete information lost by aggregation.
gaps.remaining_work: For each query retain required state and justify any exact grouping; approximate compression still needs measured error under that task and horizon.

gaps.title: Local evidence review needs a state machine and invalidation rules
gaps.original_obligation:
a simple local review-state specification and an example
from raw extraction through reviewed alternatives and revised conclusions.
Separate reviewer approval, extraction confidence and probabilities of
economic histories. Preserve previous results against their original evidence
view. Multi-user approval hierarchies are outside the current need.
gaps.current_assessment: A real printed JPMorgan reference defect is already retained. The original MC04/MC27 and G17 do not impose a monetary-only conflict condition; the current queue was narrower than their wording.
gaps.remaining_work: Check the exact target identity, then supply proposed review decisions, source preservation, rejected/admissible alternatives and selective transitive invalidation. Keep actual human adjudication pending and E05 open until the worked case is reviewed against the full obligation.

gaps.title: Reproducibility needs identity and replay definitions, not only fields
gaps.original_obligation:
explicit canonicalisation and identity rules, version and
migration contracts, and replay examples covering formatting changes, evidence
corrections, reordered independent events, duplicate event IDs and branch order.
Specify which results must be identical and which numerical comparisons have a
justified tolerance. No new cryptographic-attestation system is implied.
gaps.current_assessment: Identity/replay/migration contracts are unchanged; exact source hashes, explicit supplements and isolated candidate versions preserve documentary provenance.
gaps.remaining_work: Later crash/reopen/migration, event/stream identity and adapter recovery conformance are required. Documentary preservation checks do not establish a working persistence engine.
